actual_request.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is EDIT TARGET and its correct existing near/far leg arrangement is mandatory. Image 2 is the girl's original identity; image 3 is primary approved painting style. Create one complete newly drawn walking frame of the same bamboo archer girl facing SOUTH-EAST down-right, same camera, face, green eyes, closed smile, dark high ponytail, jade leaf clasp, ribbons, green/ivory/gold costume, short ivory trousers, boots, left-hand full bamboo bow, right-shoulder quiver, front yin-yang buckle. Upper body, head and arms steady as image1. Change only specific leg joint angles/phase below; preserve equipment and identity. The EDIT TARGET already has the CORRECT support leg: the LEFTMOST boot is LOWEST planted, and the RIGHTMOST boot is raised. PRESERVE which leg supports and this left/right foot order. Draw the pose TWO animation frames BEFORE its passing pose: move the raised rightmost thigh backward at the hip, bend its knee so the foot remains behind the planted shin and on image-right, but slightly higher than its current ankle; heel starts travelling toward hip. Keep leftmost foot planted and near shin almost vertical with a gentle six degree load bend. The pelvis sits above the leftmost support. Rightmost foot should not cross in front. Retain shorts leg openings exactly connected to the corresponding knees. Real new joint pose, not a duplicated frame. Native square >=1024x1024, full uncropped sprite, true transparent alpha; no text, no ground, no shadow, no effects. Do not mirror, translate or warp target. Repaint only to achieve real articulation, keep all original details and proportions. Frame is animation artwork, not a collage.
